text: Functional safety: IEC 61511 (process sector) with IEC 61508 for device certification. Cybersecurity: IEC 62443 (all parts). Hazardous areas: IEC 60079-10-1, ATEX 2014/34/EU. Emission monitoring: EN 14181, EN 15267-3, EN 15259. Combustion and boiler protection: NFPA 85 (functions performed in the TCS and the SIS). Alarm management: EEMUA 191 and IEC 62682 / ISA-18.2. Control valves: IEC 60534. Enclosures: IEC 60529. Communication: IEC 61850, OPC UA (IEC 62541).
